name: 质量（服务标准/检查/改进）

map.📖 查看「质量（服务标准/检查/改进）使用指南」: 📖 View the "Service Quality Inspection Checker Guide"
map.人员得分 = (持证上岗率 + 培训完成率 + 着装规范率 + 出勤率) / 4: Personnel score = (certified-staff rate + training completion + uniform compliance + attendance) / 4; service-process score = (patrol completion + access registration + response score + log completeness) / 4, where the response score is mapped from response time <=3 min = 100, <=5 = 80, <=10 = 50, >10 = 20; equipment score = (surveillance coverage + equipment working rate + communication provisioning) / 3; satisfaction score = max(0, (satisfaction + complaint resolution)/2 - max(0, monthly complaints - 5) x 3); total = personnel x 25% + process x 30% + equipment x 20% + satisfaction x 25%
map.四个维度权重合计 100%，流程权重最高是因为服务交付过程最容易被抽查取证。响应: The four dimensions sum to 100%; process carries the most weight because service delivery is the easiest part to sample and document. Response time is an inverse metric (smaller is better) and must first be converted to a 0-100 score before averaging with the other ratio metrics, otherwise "smaller is better" would be read as "lower is worse". Beyond 5 complaints each extra one deducts 3 points - a penalty above a threshold rather than a linear deduction, mimicking the "tolerance threshold" management convention; the satisfaction score is floored at 0 so negative values do not cancel it out. The total is banded as >=90 excellent, >=75 good, >=60 fair, <60 failing, used to rank remediation priorities.
map.持证上岗：保安员证持有率，应达到100%: Certified staffing: the security-guard certificate rate should reach 100%
map.事件响应时间：标准≤3分钟为优，≤5分钟为良: Incident response time: <=3 minutes is excellent, <=5 minutes is good
map.监控覆盖率：重点区域应达100%: Surveillance coverage: key areas should reach 100%
map.客户满意度：≥85%为良好，≥90%为优秀: Customer satisfaction: >=85% is good, >=90% is excellent
map.保安/物业项目月度质检：录入持证率、巡逻到位率、响应时间等 14 项，得到四维度: Monthly quality inspection for a security/property project: enter the 14 items such as certification rate, patrol completion and response time to get the four dimension scores and the total.
map.投标或续约前自查，用总分与等级说明服务水平，并列出需整改的短板项。: Self-check before bidding or renewal: use the total and grade to state the service level and list the weak items needing remediation.
map.整改后复测，对比前后总分判断措施是否真正落到关键维度。: Re-test after remediation and compare the before/after totals to judge whether the measures reached the key dimensions.
map.响应时间把流程分拉下来: Response time drags the process score down
map.其余三项均在 95% 以上，但事件响应时间 12 分钟（折算仅 20 分），服务: The other three are all above 95%, but an incident response time of 12 minutes converts to only 20 points, giving a process score of about (96+94+20+92)/4 ~ 75.5 and pulling the total down to 82; at this point improving the response process yields far more marginal gain than raising the patrol rate further.
map.满意度 92%、投诉解决率 88%、月投诉 9 次：满意度得分 =(92+88): With 92% satisfaction, an 88% complaint resolution rate and 9 monthly complaints: satisfaction score = (92+88)/2 - (9-5) x 3 = 78; holding monthly complaints below 5 raises this to 90 and lifts the total by about 3 points.
map.14 项里哪几项最影响总分？: Which of the 14 items affect the total the most?
map.服务流程权重最高（30%），其中响应时间是唯一的非线性项（≤3 分钟 100 分: Service process carries the most weight (30%), and within it response time is the only non-linear item (<=3 minutes scores 100, >10 minutes only 20), usually the one that drags the score the most.
map.某项暂时取不到数，填 0 可以吗？: If data is temporarily unavailable for an item, can I enter 0?
map.填 0 等同于完全不达标，会明显拉低该维度得分；建议按实际估算填写，或本次先不纳: Entering 0 counts as fully non-compliant and clearly lowers that dimension; estimate a realistic value instead, or leave it out of scoring this time and note it in the remarks.
map.总分 90 以上还需要整改吗？: Is remediation still needed above a total of 90?
map.需要看四维度分解。任一维度明显低于其他维度（如装备 60、其余 95）仍应专项整: Look at the four-dimension breakdown. If any dimension is clearly below the others (e.g. equipment 60 vs the rest at 95), still run targeted remediation, because in an incident the weak link is often decisive.
map.保安服务质量检查工具，从人员标准（持证/培训/着装/出勤）、服务流程（巡逻/门禁: A security-service quality inspection tool that scores 14 indicators across four dimensions - personnel standards (certification/training/uniform/attendance), service process (patrol/access/response/logs), equipment & facilities (surveillance/equipment/communication) and customer satisfaction (satisfaction/complaints) - and auto-generates improvement suggestions.
map.四维度加权评分（人员25%+流程30%+装备20%+满意度25%）: Four-dimension weighted scoring (personnel 25% + process 30% + equipment 20% + satisfaction 25%)
